description: This file defines the AdoNetFormatProvider class and its nested AdoNetFormatter class, which implement custom formatting for .NET types to be used in database queries, handling nulls, strings, DateTime, DateTimeOffset, and other IFormattable objects.

classes.name: AdoNetFormatProvider
classes.description: Implements IFormatProvider to supply custom formatting for database queries.

classes.name: AdoNetFormatter
classes.description: Implements ICustomFormatter to format various .NET types into SQL-compatible string representations.

methods.name: GetFormat
methods.description: Returns the formatter instance if the requested format type is ICustomFormatter.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats an object into a string suitable for SQL queries, handling nulls, strings, DateTime, DateTimeOffset, and other IFormattable objects.
